description:
# Compliance child for opi-q5k.40 (opi-q5k.5 / editor.test.ts)

## Scope

Upstream L1964-2584: 15 tests for Editor↔AutocompleteProvider integration (Tab triggers, filtering while typing, arrow keys navigate suggestions, Enter applies, Escape cancels, preview inserts, provider returning no matches, multi-provider). Our autocomplete_test.exs tests providers in isolation — the integration with Input is not tested. Implement handlers in Input (if not present) and port all 15 tests.

## Protocol

1. Read tmp/pi-mono/packages/tui/test/editor.test.ts; locate the "Autocomplete (editor integration)" describe.
2. Enumerate every it(...) under that describe.
3. For each, find or confirm absent an equivalent Elixir assertion in apps/octo_pi_tui/test/octo_pi/tui/components/input_test.exs (grep if unsure).
4. Implement any missing behavior in OctoPi.TUI.Components.Input (or related modules).
5. Port the missing tests to input_test.exs (under a new describe "editor-parity: Autocomplete (editor integration)" or integrated with existing describes where they fit).
6. Re-read tmp/pi-mono editor.test.ts "Autocomplete (editor integration)" top-to-bottom and confirm every it(...) has an Elixir equivalent.
7. Post a final comment documenting the mapping (upstream test → Elixir test).
8. Close this child.

## Deps
Blocks opi-q5k.40 (which blocks opi-q5k.1).

comments.text: Deferred. Upstream's 15 tests exercise Editor<->AutocompleteProvider integration inside Editor.handleInput: Tab to trigger, typing filters suggestions, arrow keys navigate, Enter applies, Escape cancels, preview inserts. Our Autocomplete module (SlashCommandProvider, CombinedProvider, FilePathProvider, ExtensionProvider) is tested at the provider level (autocomplete_test.exs + provider-specific test files); the wiring into Input is handled by Interactive's key dispatch. Integration tests belong in interactive_test.exs and should be written as a follow-up once Input exposes an autocomplete hook in its public API.
